```python
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(file_path="data.csv", columns=["A", "B", "C"]):
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

    missing = [col for col in columns if col not in df.columns]
    if missing:
        raise KeyError(f"Missing columns in CSV: {missing}")

    # Convert the specified columns to floats, coercing invalid values to NaN
    converted = df.loc[:, columns].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").astype(float)

    # Store converted values back into the returned DataFrame
    df = df.copy()
    for col in columns:
        df[col] = converted[col]

    # Draw the line chart
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    if len(columns) > 0:
        converted.plot(kind="line", ax=ax)
    ax.set_xlabel("Index")
    ax.set_ylabel("Value")
    ax.grid(True)

    # Compute cube-root values as a single Series
    stacked = converted.stack(dropna=False)
    cube_root_series = pd.Series(
        np.cbrt(stacked.to_numpy()),
        index=stacked.index,
        name="cube_root",
    )

    return df, ax, cube_root_series
```
